// diagnostic

E3005

`@{Pre|Post} contract failed: {msg}` — with file:line.

What

`@{Pre|Post} contract failed: {msg}` — with file:line.

Why

A `#Pre` (argument claim, checked at entry) or `#Post` (`result` claim, checked before return) condition evaluated false at runtime. `{msg}` is the clause's own message string. Checked in every build (not a debug/release split).

Fix

Fix the caller (a failed `#Pre` means an argument violated the function's stated contract) or the function body (a failed `#Post` means it broke its own promise about the result).

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E3005: tests/ui/runtime_e3005.stderr.
